name: the rest length fitted to one scan against the measured internuclear distance of H2's ground state

reference.ref: NIST Chemistry WebBook, H2, Constants of diatomic molecules, the row X 1Σg+, r_e in angstrom (mat-20261120-nist-webbook-h2-diatomic-constants)

note: not run in this build: the reference states no uncertainty, and the standing rule's span needs suitable materials (published values of H2's bond length with the same functional) that were not searched; the half-digit branch would judge a rest length in bohr by a digit printed in angstrom. A PBE bond length is not expected to equal a measured one. not_run is not a pass.
